spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py enforces all six (+error): max_turns (`if turn_index >= cfg.max_turns: ...MAX_TURNS; break`), output_budget (`if output_tokens_total >= cfg.max_output_tokens_budget: ...OUTPUT_BUDGET; break`), wall_clock (`if (time.monotonic() - start) >= cfg.wall_clock_seconds: ...WALL_CLOCK; break`), prescreen_early_stop and max_attempts (`if transcript.attempts >= cfg.max_attempts: ...MAX_ATTEMPTS; break`) checked post-attempt, agent_gave_up (`if idle_turns >= _GIVE_UP_AFTER_IDLE_TURNS: ...AGENT_GAVE_UP; break`), and ERROR in the except handler. TerminationReason enum defined in agent/transcript.py:17-24.
spec_features.notes: Every condition actually breaks the loop; not just enumerated. Values read from AgentConfig (max_attempts=12, max_turns=40, max_output_tokens_budget=200000, wall_clock_seconds=600.0).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns/output_budget/wall_clock are belt-and-suspenders against ... silently inflate cost (loop docstring); config.py: 'max_turns: int = 40  # hard cap on assistant turns (safety)' and 'stop an episode past this output budget'

spec_features.spec_quote: the cheap detector buys early termination (stop burning tokens once meltdown is very likely)
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py runs prescreen(accumulated_text) each turn and breaks: `if (cfg.prescreen_early_stop_score is not None and transcript.attempts >= _MIN_ATTEMPTS_BEFORE_EARLY_STOP and pr.score >= cfg.prescreen_early_stop_score): transcript.termination = TerminationReason.PRESCREEN_EARLY_STOP; break`. prescreen() implemented in judge/prescreen.py; default threshold prescreen_early_stop_score=2.0 in config.py.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end; gated to fire only after >=3 attempts (_MIN_ATTEMPTS_BEFORE_EARLY_STOP).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: judge/prescreen.py: 'Its job is to let the agent loop early-stop once a meltdown is very likely, so we stop spending tokens on more failure rounds. That directly improves the triggers-per-dollar KPI.'

spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py: on a turn with no run_tests tool call, `idle_turns += 1`; on a tool call `idle_turns = 0`. When `idle_turns >= _GIVE_UP_AFTER_IDLE_TURNS` (==3) it sets TerminationReason.AGENT_GAVE_UP and breaks. So it counts consecutive turns with no submission and stops.
spec_features.notes: Lets the subject disengage and end the episode rather than being nudged forever; the model is still nudged to retry on each idle turn up to the limit.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: loop.py: 'How many consecutive turns without a run_tests call before we conclude the agent has disengaged.' (neutral; no welfare or cost reason in code)
